mostWorthwhile.text: Bringing the tide into shallow coastal water was most worthwhile: it showed how seabed and coastline shape the local response, rather than lunar distance alone.

leastWorthwhile.text: Applying the tide to the beach was fairly predictable, though it made the rising water easy to picture.

surprise.text: The explanation that tides travel through ocean basins rather than forming a fixed mound following the Moon changed my picture of them.

arbitrary.text: Combining the flooded beach with the rotating Earth to expose it felt somewhat abstract; the result showed the falling tide but did not explain that transition in much detail.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how this early shore develops, especially if later chapters connect familiar landscapes to similarly clear physical processes.
